commun: Image 1 gives only the mood and the brushwork, very low weight: never copy its building. Paint one forest mass seen from the game's isometric camera: several trees that overlap into one clump, read as a single silhouette with a varied, broken top edge. Each crown is made of big rounded clumps of leaves painted with brush strokes, a lit top on the left, a mid tone and a cool slate shaded side on the right. No single leaf drawn on its own, no floating leaves, no leaf icons on the crowns. The trunks and roots stand directly on the flat magenta backdrop: no grass, no soil, no ground plate, no base of any shape under the trees. The trees are cut out like a sticker: below and between the trunks there is only the pure magenta backdrop, the lowest painted pixels are the roots themselves.

sujets.feuillus: A clump of six to eight broad oaks and beeches of different heights, warm olive-green crowns, a few thick trunks visible at the front.
sujets.melangee: A mixed clump of five broadleaf trees and four tall dark firs, the firs rising above the round crowns at the back.
sujets.bouleaux: A light grove of seven young birches, slender white trunks with black marks, small airy crowns of yellow-green leaves, gaps between them.
sujets.dense: A dense deep-forest mass of ten to twelve trees packed tight, dark moss-green crowns, almost no trunk visible, the darkest of the forest.
sujets.bord_coniferes: A long wall of fifteen to twenty firs and spruces packed shoulder to shoulder, very dark, almost black blue-green, no broadleaf tree, a closed edge of the world, nothing can be seen through it.
sujets.bord_crete: A long low ridge of dark grey rocks with very dark firs growing on and behind it, a closed edge of the world, rock faces lit on the left and slate in shade on the right, no broadleaf tree.

bloc: Franco-Belgian comic game art, three-quarter isometric view from above. First the ink: a bold, clean, confident black outline (#0F1518) of even width around the whole silhouette, about five pixels wide, thinner inner lines. Then the colour, painted inside the ink with visible brush strokes, two or three values per surface, matte, no gloss; the brush stays inside the lines and never breaks the outline. Warm late-afternoon light from the upper left: left and top surfaces lit warm (#DEC28B, #C8965E); the shaded side of every form is cool slate blue-grey (#2E3552), never brown. Earth #6E5941, dark earth #554232, foliage #4C7A3E, moss #435A36. Image 1 gives only the mood: do not copy its thin line or its brown shadows. No cast shadow outside the object's own base. One object alone, centred, on a flat uniform pure magenta (#FF00FF) backdrop from edge to edge, all four corners. No text, no signature.
